description:
Job Description: 
 Analytical Mechanics Associates, Inc (AMA) is seeking a part-time intern to support the Flight Dynamics Research Facility at NASA Langley Research Center. The CAD Model Design Intern will support the Entry Systems Modeling project to develop free flight and forced oscillation model design for rapid prototype fabrication. Project activities include but are not limited to, forced oscillation and free flight tests to investigate the dynamic stability of blunt entry vehicles. The models to be tested include variations of geometries. Forced oscillation testing and free flight testing will provide static and dynamic stability data for the geometries tested as well as free flight dynamics which will serve as validation data for trajectory simulation analysis.
 Responsibilities 
 Develop models in in the form of .igs or .stp, as well as the native CAD format used for the design work
 Develop CAD models for oscillation configurations that include location of mounting interface at specified reference points,
 Design geometry to accommodate thermal inset fasteners for accurate and reliable mounting to the balance sting
 Create CAD solid models of free flight wind tunnel models using FDM 3D printing methods or similar.
 Design the models to enable a movable center of gravity
 Requirements 
 Undergraduate or Graduate student with a degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering
 Minimum of 2 years’ experience in developing CAD models or 2 semesters of relevant CAD course

title: Quantitative Developer Intern
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a highly motivated, intellectually curious, mission-driven software engineer to join our Markets team. As an intern, you’ll work on high-impact problems critical to Base’s success and deliver solutions alongside full-time team members.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Algorithms & Optimization: 

At Base, we operate distributed energy resources that trade in real-time electricity and ancillary service markets. You’ll help design and implement sequential decision algorithms that determine when and how to trade. Responsibilities will include:

 - Designing algorithms for trading a fleet of energy storage resources in ERCOT.

 - Validating physics- and economics-based models in a simulation environment.

 - Implementing and deploying new algorithms to our production trading stack.



Risk & Trading: 

Base also enters into financial contracts to hedge against volatility in electricity markets. You’ll help identify, evaluate, and automate new hedging strategies. Responsibilities will include:

 - Quantifying long-term financial risk under different operating strategies.

title: Software Engineering Intern
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Base, we're building BaseOS: the operating system that runs the modern power company. It's the firmware on batteries in more than 15,000 homes nationally, the algorithms that balance power in real-time energy markets, the internal tools that deploy and operate a fleet installing roughly 150 batteries a day, and the product members use to see and control their energy.

As a software engineering intern, you'll ship real code that runs in production on systems that keep power flowing to real homes. You'll work on problems that touch the whole company: balancing electrons in milliseconds, scaling operations into new markets, and automating things most utilities still do by hand.

This is one of the few places where every line of code has real consequences, in homes, on the grid, and in how Base grows.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build production systems. Design, build, and deploy production-grade software across the stack, from embedded firmware to backend infrastructure to member-facing products.

 - Ship under real constraints. Write code that runs under real-world condition

The primary goal is simple: a user should never have to install anything or leave our app to take a chip from idea to finished design. Valstad is building the machine that builds the ships.

Valstad is rebuilding how ships are made.

American shipbuilding is constrained by slow, labor-intensive production methods and a shortage of skilled manufacturing capacity. We are developing robotic production systems that can turn engineering data directly into finished steel structures, dramatically reducing the time and manual programming required to build ships.

Our first platform combines industrial robots, automated material handling, welding, sensing and AI-driven manufacturing software to produce large ship panels and structural assemblies. description:
General Role Description 
 Assist in the development and implementation of financial models and analyses that support strategic decision-making and gain practical experience in financial forecasting, budgeting, and performance analysis, working closely with experienced finance professionals.
 Role Accountabilities 
 · The Intern will work in one or more of the following areas:
 · Conduct financial analysis and modeling to support business decisions
 · Assist in the development of annual budgets and forecasts
 · Monitor and analyze financial performance against budget and forecast
 · Identify and communicate financial risks and opportunities
 · Analyze the trends of key performance indicators (KPIs), especially relating to financial metrics such as sales, expenses, and profit margin
 · Monitor KPIs and identify the cause of any unexpected variances
 · Develop and continually improve budgeting, financial projections, and operating forecasts
 · Ad-hoc business performance reporting
 · Ensure completion of assignments within the defined scope, quality, and time
 · Provide regular, accurate and considered status reports to parties deemed appropriate to the situation
 General Employee Accountabilities 
 · Bring full effort to bear on tasks assigned by manager
 · Give manager best advice
 · Give earliest notice when work cannot be delivered as specified
 · Cooperate and collaborate with peers and interact cross-organizationally as specified by manager
 · Exemplify Company Core Value
